conditions.label: motion
conditions.workload_control: Externally prepared visible host scene; label is descriptive only.

definitions.cpu_percent_one_core: 100% is one CPU core; multi-threaded totals can exceed 100%.
definitions.server: Only the selected Rust server process. WindowServer, fixture browser, Python and other OS services are excluded.
definitions.client: The newly launched Chromium browser and its descendants, including renderer and GPU-process CPU/RSS. Python and the Playwright Node driver are excluded.
definitions.memory: Resident set size sampled once per second, MiB. Client RSS is summed across processes and may double-count shared pages; it is not unique physical memory or GPU memory.
definitions.gpu: GPU hardware utilization, video-engine utilization, GPU memory and WindowServer resources are not measured.
definitions.rendered_fps: Successful remote-canvas drawImage submissions per browser monotonic second; not physical display presentation FPS.
definitions.received_binary_payload_mbps: WebSocket binary payload bytes including the 5-byte H264 envelope; excludes TCP/TLS/WebSocket framing and text control messages. Not an external-network throughput test.
definitions.receive_to_draw_ms: In-browser binary message arrival through drawImage return, FIFO within each codec (baseline H264 without B-frames and serial JPEG). Includes client decode/queue/draw submission; excludes capture, encode, network transit and GPU completion.
definitions.draw_submission_ms: Only Canvas2D drawImage call duration; GPU completion is asynchronous.
definitions.ui_render_ms: Once-per-second samples of the app's displayed rolling mean: JPEG decode+draw; H264 packet processing through decoded draw. These sample means are not frame-weighted.
definitions.capture_ms: Server's roughly once-per-second capture call timing. XCap: synchronous capture. SCK: latest async sample map/copy only; OS scaling and capture run upstream. Excludes worker queue wait; not every frame.
definitions.unique_capture_fps: Distinct source sequence numbers in transmitted frames per second, using first/last server stats. SCK duplicate latest samples count once; XCap/demo each synchronous capture counts once. Not pixel-difference or physical presentation FPS.
definitions.capture_age_ms: SCK callback arrival through selected-sample CPU copy completion, not total glass-to-glass latency.
definitions.encode_ms: Server's roughly once-per-second resize, color conversion and encoding timing samples; not every frame.
definitions.cpu_limitations: CPU deltas include polling instrumentation overhead in the client. Final CPU between the last sample and a child process exit cannot be recovered and may slightly undercount.
definitions.comparison: One sequential run, no quality-equivalence assertion. Static and motion results require separately prepared scenes. Same-machine server/client compete for resources.
